# Asciidoctor 2.0.26 reference profile

The reference is the MIT-licensed Asciidoctor Ruby gem 2.0.26, released
2025-10-24. Its gem SHA-256 is pinned in `PROFILE.json`. The focused corpus is
original Markup++ test material and is covered by this repository's license.

Ordinary tests are offline. A maintainer with Ruby and the pinned gem may use
`tests/asciidoctor_reference.py` to regenerate raw reference evidence. Markup++
does not vendor or execute Ruby code at runtime.
